summary: Embark on an epic adventure in a dark, strange, fantasy world. No Ads or IAP.
description:
Discover new challenges, and steer the game's Narrative as you venture to destroy the Dark Lord's Tower. Your loyal company of Knights and Soldiers, the Unknown Knights, will stand by you every step of the journey.

- Included in Top 10 of Google Indie Game Festival 2019 (Korea)
- Selected as an Indie game exhibitor in Samsung Developer Conference 2019 (San Jose, California)

"Unknown Knights" provides unique unit battles with roguelike encounters. You must solve problems, hire knights, and draft militia to build a strong band for the final fight against the Dark Lord.

KEY FEATURES

◆Real-Time ACTION Strategy
Control multiple units in real-time with four buttons. Timing your Actions is key; Read enemy movements and react accordingly. - Attack, Defense, Parry, and Charge.

◆The Journey and Choices
Hundreds of random encounters will pop up during the journey. Each of them has different choices and consequences. Some of the results of your decision won't happen immediately but surely come back to you.

◆Hidden Bosses & Relics to Discover
Your name will spread in the world as you continue your journey. Wandering wizards, underground monsters and leaders of factions will come to you to challenge or give a request.

◆Content
- 290+ events and stories, all affected by user choice
- 350+ battles
- Knights with 13 different specialties
- Enemy Factions that includes Dark Lord's Army, Thieves, the Assassins, and the Royal Guards
- Randomly generated play map and different ways to unlock gifts
- Dynamic Weather, providing weather-based strategies
- Three different difficulties designed for players of different skill levels
- 10 hidden bosses can be found throughout gameplay
- Online Ranking

The following permissions are necessary to play this game.
[Storage Access]
Permission: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
Permission: WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
This permission is for saving game data on external memory cards.

※ The game is available for offline playing.
※ No Ads or Microtransactions
